page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance provisioned through the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at a base frequency of 3.2 GHz. The configuration allocates 12 dedicated vCPUs and 24.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The server profile incorporates a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local disk storage is not bundled with this type, requiring attached network block storage for operating system binaries and persistent data retention. It also does not feature discrete GPU accelerators.

By maintaining a dense 1:2 vCPU-to-memory footprint, the hardware optimizes cost efficiency for computational tasks that do not demand extensive RAM pools. Tradeoffs include reliance on network-attached storage for disk operations and a lack of hardware acceleration. The instance is suited for compute-focused workloads such as CI/CD build environments, batch jobs, application web servers, and distributed computational worker nodes.
